name: dead-drop
description: Asynchronous agent-to-agent messages between Claude Code sessions working in different repositories. Agent A writes a markdown message into repo B's a2a/ folder and pings B by SendMessage if it is running; B's SessionStart hook lists open messages, B acts on them, sets any reminders the message asks for in its own scheduler, and records what it did in the same file. For long tasks the sender keeps one living message current (revision: counter) and asks the reader to re-check it on an interval (watch: 30m). No server and no shared meeting place: the target repo's folder is the mailbox. Breakout (an idea that needs its own new repo) and same-repo handover are message kinds.
